lookup.who: SELECT id FROM members WHERE display_name = 'SMOKE Keep Portal Customer' AND member_kind = 'human'

lookup.updated: SELECT 'yes' FROM members WHERE id = {{who}} AND job_title = 'SMOKE {{run}} Title' AND timezone = 'America/Chicago'

lookup.suspended: SELECT 'yes' FROM members WHERE id = {{who}} AND status = 'suspended'
lookup.holds_nothing: SELECT 'yes' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM applications a, app_member_grants(a.id, {{who}}))

lookup.active: SELECT 'yes' FROM members WHERE id = {{who}} AND status = 'active'
lookup.logged: SELECT 'yes' FROM activity_log WHERE entity_id = {{who}} AND action IN ('member.suspend', 'member.reinstate', 'member.update') HAVING count(DISTINCT action) = 3
